_about: All wall-time measurements of one Pacoima 1000 x 1000 tile-day from scripts/bench_fast_sky.py on 30 Oct 2026 (RTX 4070 Laptop GPU, WSL2, UTCI and Tmrt saved). bench_fast_sky.json only keeps the latest invocation, so all invocations are recorded here from the run logs. Invocations 1-4 used the fast sky with chunk 64; 5-6 with chunk 8. Invocations 5-6 ran after a ViT training job on the same GPU was paused.

legend.A: original, outputs on the Windows drive (/mnt/c)
legend.B: original, outputs on the WSL Linux file system (median of 45.3, 47.1, 65.6, 49.6)
legend.D: + fast ground view factors, chunk 64 (mean of 25.1, 25.5)
legend.F: all three fixes + bit-packed masks (mean of 23.7, 23.2)
